verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a path from a managed model to registered payment facilitation, PayFac registration, or moving between liability models without replatforming. Monetization and fee-customization docs (finix-docs-11, finix-docs-25) cover economics within the platform model. They are adjacent features and do not show the graduation path the story asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, there's a path up the stack — start on the managed model and graduate toward registered payment facilitation with more economics and control, without replatforming
